title: Your asks, re-judged after today: what moved to done, on the tally page

chat.text: The asks tally was computed at 17:41, before about forty tasks landed. Every feature is re-judged against today's landing lines, today's dictations are added as asks, and the page opens with "what changed today": the features that moved from not done or partly to done, each with its landing link; ten of the changed verdicts spot-checked.
